# LMDSys
LMDSys is the Medicaid Legislative Decision Support System. Its initial audience
is legislators, legislative analysts, Medicaid leadership, and budget and
oversight staff. The product is intended to explain where Medicaid money is
going, what is driving change, and which policy, contracting, program, or
data-quality interventions warrant examination.

The project is in requirements discovery. It does not yet contain a runnable
